query: ALTER TABLE container_registry_layer_manifest ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_layer_manifest_chk_sha_manifest_digest CHECK(manifest_digest ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_layer_manifest_chk_sha_layer_blob CHECK(layer_blob_digest ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_layer_manifest_fk_manifest_digest FOREIGN KEY(manifest_digest) REFERENCES container_registry_manifest(digest), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_layer_manifest_fk_layer_blob_digest FOREIGN KEY(layer_blob_digest) REFERENCES container_registry_layer_blob(digest);
